layout_raw.reading: the picture as generated against the certified wall/floor boundary: the ratio >> 1 and most columns within 8 px = the layout was kept; the signed offset is where the picture's boundary sits relative to the certified one (+ = lower on screen)

drift.reading: scale about the horizon and shift of the picture's wall/floor boundary relative to the certified one

layout_registered.reading: the same oracle after undoing the drift: whether the treatment is usable as an asset once registered to the certified geometry

calibration.reference: band ratio 19.97, offset 0, within_8px 0.996 (drift 98-100 percent, +0..+3 px)
calibration.reference_rolled_25_rows: band ratio 0.10, offset -25, within_8px 0.026; registered: shift -21, within_8px 0.974
calibration.reference_rolled_100_rows: band ratio 0.77, within_8px 0.214 (beyond the +-48 search: not recoverable, as it should be)
calibration.note: measured on this tree with these constants; the earlier raw-gradient ratio was texture-confounded on painted pictures and is retired
